; Settings entry, replay-gated to exact supported Move firmware resources.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT cn.rmtool.QrUpload 1.0
    TRAVERSE Background#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            ImportControl { settings: Settings }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Settings.qml
    IMPORT cn.rmtool.QrUpload 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar > ColumnLayout#settingsColumn
        LOCATE AFTER Item
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: rmtoolQrSidebarItem
                objectName: "rmtoolQrSidebarItem"
                type: ArkTokens.Sidebar.primary
                text: showLabels ? "扫码传输" : ""
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/import"
                highlighted: root._selectedPage === 1004
                focusPolicy: Qt.StrongFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onTriggered: {
                    root._selectedPage = 1004
                    sidebarTimer.running = true
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#payloadLoader
        REBUILD sourceComponent
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM /{/
            INSERT STREAM /if (root._selectedPage === 1004) return rmtoolQrTransfer;/
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE Item#root
        LOCATE BEFORE Component#general
        INSERT {
            Component {
                id: rmtoolQrTransfer
                Item {
                    id: rmtoolQrPage
                    objectName: "rmtoolQrTransferPage"

                    QrUpload { id: rmtoolQrBridge; settings: Settings }
                    onVisibleChanged: { if (!visible) rmtoolQrBridge.stop() }
                    Component.onDestruction: rmtoolQrBridge.stop()
                    Connections {
                        target: PowerManager
                        function onPowerButtonShortPress() { rmtoolQrBridge.stop() }
                    }
                    Connections {
                        target: Qt.application
                        function onStateChanged() {
                            if (Qt.application.state !== Qt.ApplicationActive) rmtoolQrBridge.stop()
                        }
                    }

                    ScrollArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: rmtoolQrWrapper.childrenRect.height
                            + ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                        enableScrollbar: true
                        permanentScrollbar: true
                        Item {
                            id: rmtoolQrWrapper
                            implicitWidth: parent.width
                            ArkControls.PlaceholderBar {
                                id: rmtoolQrPlaceholder
                                width: parent.width
                            }
                            ArkControls.Title {
                                id: rmtoolQrHeader
                                type: ArkControls.Title.Large
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolQrPlaceholder.bottom
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                text: "扫码传输"
                            }
                            ColumnLayout {
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolQrHeader.bottom
                                    topMargin: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                spacing: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                                ArkControls.Body {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
                                    text: rmtoolQrBridge.status
                                }
                                ArkControls.Body {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    visible: rmtoolQrBridge.filename.length > 0
                                    Layout.minimumWidth: 0
                                    Layout.preferredWidth: 0
                                    text: rmtoolQrBridge.filename
                                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
                                    elide: Text.ElideMiddle
                                    maximumLineCount: 1
                                }
                                ArkControls.ProgressBar {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    visible: rmtoolQrBridge.progress >= 0
                                    value: Math.max(0, rmtoolQrBridge.progress) / 100
                                }
                                ArkControls.Body {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    visible: rmtoolQrBridge.transferDetail.length > 0
                                    text: rmtoolQrBridge.transferDetail
                                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                }
                                RowLayout {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium
                                    ArkControls.Button {
                                        text: "开启接收"
                                        type: ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                        enabled: !rmtoolQrBridge.busy
                                        onClicked: rmtoolQrBridge.start()
                                    }
                                    ArkControls.Button {
                                        text: "停止接收"
                                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                        enabled: rmtoolQrBridge.busy
                                        onClicked: rmtoolQrBridge.stop()
                                    }
                                }
                                Rectangle {
                                    Layout.preferredWidth: Math.min(360, rmtoolQrPage.width - 100)
                                    Layout.preferredHeight: Layout.preferredWidth
                                    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                                    color: "white"
                                    visible: rmtoolQrBridge.url.length > 0
                                    QRCodeProvider {
                                        id: rmtoolQrProvider
                                        text: rmtoolQrBridge.url
                                    }
                                    Image {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        anchors.margins: 16
                                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                                        source: rmtoolQrBridge.url.length > 0 ? rmtoolQrProvider.imageUrl : ""
                                        smooth: false
                                    }
                                }
                                ArkControls.Body {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                    visible: rmtoolQrBridge.expires.length > 0
                                    text: "有效至 " + rmtoolQrBridge.expires
                                }
                                ArkControls.Body {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                    text: "PDF / EPUB，单个文件不超过 200 MB；更大文件推荐使用 USB 传输。"
                                }
                                ArkControls.Body {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                    text: "传输未加密，仅限可信 Wi-Fi。请勿在公共网络上传敏感文件。"
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
